segments.sn23.34:1.2: Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā rādho bhagavantaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn23.34:1.3: “sādhu me, bhante, bhagavā saṃkhittena dhammaṃ desetu, yamahaṃ bhagavato dhammaṃ sutvā eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto vihareyyan”ti.
segments.sn23.34:2.1: “Yo kho, rādha, nirodhadhammo; tatra te chando pahātabbo, rāgo pahātabbo, chandarāgo pahātabbo.
segments.sn23.34:2.3: Rūpaṃ kho, rādha, nirodhadhammo; tatra te chando pahātabbo … pe …
segments.sn23.34:2.4: vedanā nirodhadhammo; tatra te chando pahātabbo … pe …
segments.sn23.34:2.5: saññā nirodhadhammo; tatra te chando pahātabbo … pe …
segments.sn23.34:2.6: saṅkhārā nirodhadhammo; tatra te chando pahātabbo … pe …
segments.sn23.34:2.7: viññāṇaṃ nirodhadhammo; tatra te chando pahātabbo … pe …
segments.sn23.34:2.8: yo kho, rādha, nirodhadhammo; tatra te chando pahātabbo, rāgo pahātabbo, chandarāgo pahātabbo”ti [sīhaḷapotthake pana imasmiṃ vagge chattiṃsa suttāni vibhattāni ekekaṃ suttaṃ tīṇi tīṇi katvā, evaṃ catutthavaggepi].

lines: Tathāgatassa imaṃ theraṃ disvā sukhumaṃ kāraṇaṃ upaṭṭhāti.
Evaṃ imasmiṃ rādhasaṃyutte ādito dve vaggā pucchāvasena desitā, tatiyo āyācanena, catuttho upanisinnakakathāvasena.
Sakalampi panetaṃ rādhasaṃyuttaṃ therassa vimuttiparipācanīyadhammavaseneva gahitanti veditabbaṃ.
182-205. Sukhumaṃ kāraṇaṃ upaṭṭhāti, tenesa thero paṭibhāneyyakānaṃ etadagge ṭhapito.
